title: Create: BudPack
description: Tech in a semi-lightweight suit? Create: BudPack has it!
body:
Want to play create with friends, but all the modpacks you find nowadays are unoriginal and boring?
I present to you; Create: BudPack. A create modpack that focuses itself on trying to be as original as possible.
In doing so means that there are custom recipes handmade to fit the modpack,
and there will soon be custom machinery and quests.
Create: BudPack tries to make recipes (especially Create mod recipes) semi-realistic,
adding slight realism to new recipes. 
This mod contains two primary mods, those being Create and Buddycards. Hence the name, this mod will eventually have a goal to strive for but will for now remain a kitchen sink modpack.

This modpack is still being made and lacks sufficient supporters, if you want to support me and/or show
appreciation best you can do is join the official Discord server and suggest mods, quests and recipes or tell me about potential bugs.
